rdfs:label: Mention
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Link representing a mention of an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) — typically authored as `@user@host` and attached to an Object as a tag.
notes: Use as a value of `as:tag` with the actor's IRI in `href`. Servers such as Mastodon use Mention tags to generate notifications and linkify the text, but the post is only delivered if the mentioned actor is also in `as:to`/`as:cc` — include both. Distinct from a Hashtag (topical, not addressed).

history.note: Replaced the nonexistent Actor alias in seeAlso with urn:solid:Person; notes clarify delivery needs to/cc in addition to the Mention tag.
